analysis.title: DEM Fatale: Hartnett Says Blue Wave Marked "Peak AI" As Every Wall Street Bull Conviction Dies But One
key_insights: Hartnett's Flow Show calls the 2026 midterms 'peak AI equity concentration'. The AI Big 10 peaked at 41% of US market cap, matching the TMT bubble and just below Japan's 44% in 1989.

Incoming Democratic governors have promised data center moratoria. Goldman estimates moratoria could freeze roughly 45% of planned US capacity, with Texas alone about a quarter. Microsoft pulled out of an Oracle AI rental on Friday.
Hyperscaler bonds sold off after the election. AI high-yield data center bonds fell sharply, with CoreWeave leading the drop. Hartnett still says 'tech bonds > tech stocks'.

Goldman counted five hyperscaler bond deals worth $67B since Oct 29. YTD issuance is $296B against Goldman's $250B full-year forecast, and the risk to spreads into December is 'firmly tilted towards more widening'.
Consensus hyperscaler capex is $1.3tn in 2027 with free cash flow of -$252B. A week earlier Hartnett had those figures at about $1.2tn and -$180B.

YTD scoreboard: oil 58.8%, global stocks 8.8%, US stocks 7.4%, US dollar 3.2%, cash 3.2%, HY bonds -0.1%, IG -1.4%, govt bonds -2.0%, gold -5.3%, bitcoin -13.0%. Bitcoin now trails gold by almost eight points.

Hartnett's Biggest Picture trade is to buy gold into the debt ceiling. The new Congress is sworn in Jan 3 and the US hits the $41.1tn ceiling Feb 1. Gold rose 12% and 17% in the 3 months before the 2011 and 2023 ceilings.

Hartnett stays risk-off until central bank hikes end, the 10-year UST yield is below 4.5% and oil is below $80/bbl. A weak Nov CPI and payrolls would make the Dec Fed/ECB/BoJ hikes the last and start a year-end rally.

Friday payrolls rose 165K against a consensus of less than half that, and unemployment fell to 4.1%. The 10Y closed near 4.85% and oil is near $90, so the data and yield conditions for a Thanksgiving rally are failing. Tuesday's CPI is the last chance before the Dec 9 FOMC.

Hartnett's levels broke: NVDA below 200 (closed $186.64), TSM below 400 (closed $375.44), MAGS below $70 (closed $67.53). SOX is 17% below its 200-day moving average, against Hartnett's historic entry points at 20-25% below.
Recession canaries are mixed. IXG holds at $130.05 against a $125 line and JNK at $92.70 against $92. MDY closed at $657.82, below Hartnett's $666 line.

BofA Global FMS tracked bull convictions: no hike, no sweep, no cut in AI capex. The Fed hiked in September and Democrats swept, leaving 'boom' as the last bull conviction, at its highest since Feb'22.
Hartnett's midterm trades: gold > oil, lower yields, tech bonds > tech stocks, consumer stocks > energy, small cap > monopolies, long Europe, long China tech. He also says sell oil and buy bonds.
Rate path: the Fed hiked Sep 16 with a 64% probability of another hike Dec 9. ECB is 76% and BOE 50% for Dec 17, BOJ 68% for Dec 18. There have been 55 hikes this year against 11 expected in January.
Hartnett's 2027 scenarios are bubble, breadth and bust. He says consensus conviction in bubble has peaked and expects downward revisions to '27 global tech EPS growth of 45%, after 94% in '26.

Flows in the week through Wednesday: $140.4bn to cash, $89.2bn to stocks, $11.6bn to bonds, $0.1bn to gold, $1.8bn from crypto. Global equities took a record $265.6bn over 4 weeks and China stocks a record $85.9bn.
BofA Bull & Bear Indicator rose to 7.2 from 7.1 and is neutral. The Global Breadth Rule buy signal triggers at 88% oversold. Currently 16% are oversold, and Hartnett says it awaits SPX below 7323.

The author leans toward the bust case. They argue Friday's jobs data went the opposite way from what a Thanksgiving rally needed, and that hyperscalers are front-running 2027 bond supply while the window is open.

tension_points.bull_case: Hartnett says slower capex, less cash burn and less issuance is what creditors want. Once yields reset lower with no recession, AI stocks return and the 'spenders' outperform the 'builders'.
tension_points.bear_case: The author says a buildout slowed by governors leaves half-built campuses and $4.1 trillion of off-balance sheet commitments to be paid, and the hyperscalers are front-running 2027 supply.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Recession odds rising: MDY below $666 has already happened, and JNK below $92 or IXG below $125 would add to it.

tension_points.bull_case: If Nov CPI and payrolls are weak, the Dec Fed/ECB/BoJ hikes are the last and risk assets rally into year-end.
tension_points.bear_case: Friday payrolls of +165K, the 10Y near 4.85% and oil near $90 fail Hartnett's conditions, and SF Fed's Daly said more hikes are likely needed.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A hot Nov CPI on Nov 10 ahead of the Dec 9 FOMC. The 10Y staying above 4.5% and oil above $80 keeps Hartnett risk-off.

tension_points.bull_case: Breadth case: consensus sees UST yields down 40bps and 15% S&P EPS growth in 2027, which unlocks small and mid-caps.
tension_points.bear_case: Bust case: bonds and voters end booms, credit tightening ends the AI boom, and 2027 forecasts for US nominal GDP and global tech EPS get revised down.
tension_points.what_invalidates: SPX holds above 7k while recession odds stay low, which Hartnett says means no retreat.
